questions.question: What does a private endpoint provide for an Azure Storage account?

options.text: A private IP address from your virtual network
A public IP address on the internet

questions.explanation: Private endpoints bring services into your VNet via Private Link.

questions.question: Which statement describes a public endpoint?

options.text: It is reachable over the internet
It is only reachable from inside a VNet
It is a type of VM size

questions.question: Which technology enables private endpoints?
questions.explanation: Private Link maps a private IP to a specific Azure resource.
